llm_response.reason: The website displays several classic scam indicators: an implausibly broad range of products, suspicious business information (unknown company name, use of unrelated email domain), and commonly reported red flags (too-good-to-be-true offers of free/discounted services). Trust checkers and scam reporting sites explicitly warn against it, labeling it as very high risk and likely fraudulent. The site's attributes match multiple characteristics of fake shopping scams, including suspicious contact methods, excessive urgency and breadth of inventory, and reputation as a scam in independent reviews.
